description: Open a protocol governance proposal: set scope to 'emission_param' or 'protocol_upgrade', and for 'emission_param' also pass paramKey and proposedValue. Protocol governance is not enabled by default. The call is forwarded to the operator endpoint you configured, so expect an error rather than an open vote unless that operator has turned governance on. Where it is enabled it returns a hex proposalId that saihm_governance_vote takes, and it starts a vote rather than changing a setting.
name: saihm_governance_propose
title: Propose (governance)
